display.label: Azure Application Gateway
display.description: Azure Application Gateway (Layer 7) web traffic load balancer with SSL termination, autoscale, and optional WAF

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Application Gateway. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Application Gateway identity, resource group, and region settings.

fields.label: Application Gateway Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Application Gateway. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The name of the Resource Group in which to create the Application Gateway.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: The Azure Region where the Application Gateway should be created.

fields.label: Availability Zones
fields.description: Availability Zones in which this Application Gateway should be deployed (e.g. 1, 2, 3).

fields.label: Enable HTTP/2
fields.description: Whether HTTP/2 is enabled on the Application Gateway.

sections.label: SKU & Autoscale
sections.description: SKU size, tier, and autoscale capacity configuration.

fields.label: SKU Settings
fields.description: SKU name and tier for the Application Gateway.

fields.label: SKU Name
fields.description: Name of the SKU.

fields.label: SKU Tier
fields.description: Tier of the SKU.

fields.label: Static Capacity
fields.description: Static capacity instance count (applicable when autoscale is not configured).

fields.label: Autoscale Configuration
fields.description: Minimum and maximum capacity instances for v2 SKUs.

fields.label: Minimum Capacity
fields.description: Minimum capacity units (0 to 100).

fields.label: Maximum Capacity
fields.description: Maximum capacity units (2 to 125).

sections.label: Network & Frontend IP Configuration
sections.description: Gateway IP and frontend listener port/IP configurations.

fields.label: Gateway IP Configurations
fields.description: Subnet configuration for the Application Gateway. Must be a dedicated subnet.

fields.label: Configuration Name
fields.description: Name of the gateway IP configuration.

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the subnet dedicated to the Application Gateway.

fields.label: Frontend IP Configurations
fields.description: Public or private IP configurations used by frontend listeners.

fields.label: Frontend IP Name
fields.description: Name of the frontend IP configuration.

fields.label: Public IP Address ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the Public IP address for public traffic.

fields.label: Private Subnet ID
fields.description: Resource ID of the subnet for private frontend traffic.

fields.label: Private IP Address
fields.description: Specific private IP address if static allocation is used.

fields.label: Private IP Allocation
fields.description: Allocation method for private IP.

fields.label: Private Link Configuration Name
fields.description: The name of any associated Private Link configuration.

fields.label: Frontend Ports
fields.description: Ports on which the Application Gateway listens.

fields.label: Port Name
fields.description: Name of the frontend port configuration.

fields.label: Port Number
fields.description: Port number (1-65502).

sections.label: Backends, HTTP Settings & Listeners
sections.description: Backend target pools, HTTP routing settings, and listener configurations.

fields.label: Backend Address Pools
fields.description: Target pools of backends (IP addresses or FQDNs).

fields.label: Pool Name
fields.description: Name of the backend address pool.

fields.label: Backend FQDNs
fields.description: List of FQDNs (e.g. app.azurewebsites.net).

fields.label: Backend IP Addresses
fields.description: List of IP addresses.

fields.label: Backend HTTP Settings
fields.description: HTTP/HTTPS communication settings with backend servers.

fields.label: Settings Name
fields.description: Name of the backend HTTP settings.

fields.label: Backend Port
fields.description: Port number on the backend servers.

fields.label: Protocol
fields.description: Protocol to use for backend communication.

fields.label: Cookie-Based Affinity
fields.description: Whether cookie-based session affinity is enabled.

fields.label: Affinity Cookie Name
fields.description: Name of cookie used for session affinity.

fields.label: Path Prefix
fields.description: Path prefix to append to request URI.

fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Request timeout in seconds (1 to 86400).

fields.label: Health Probe Name
fields.description: Name of custom health probe to associate.

fields.label: Host Header Override
fields.description: Host header override sent to backend servers.

fields.label: Pick Host Name from Backend
fields.description: Automatically pick host header from backend address.

fields.label: Trusted Root Certificate Names
fields.description: List of trusted root certificate names for backend HTTPS.

fields.label: HTTP Listeners
fields.description: Frontend listeners that receive incoming traffic.

fields.label: Listener Name
fields.description: Name of the HTTP listener.

fields.label: Frontend IP Name
fields.description: Name of the associated frontend IP configuration.

fields.label: Frontend Port Name
fields.description: Name of the associated frontend port.

fields.label: Protocol
fields.description: Protocol to listen on.

fields.label: Host Name
fields.description: Specific host name to listen for (e.g. app.example.com).

fields.label: Multiple Host Names
fields.description: List of host names for multi-site listeners.

fields.label: Require SNI
fields.description: Whether Server Name Indication is required for HTTPS.

fields.label: SSL Certificate Name
fields.description: Name of SSL certificate for HTTPS listeners.

fields.label: SSL Profile Name
fields.description: Name of SSL profile to associate.

fields.label: WAF Policy ID
fields.description: Listener-level Web Application Firewall policy ID.

sections.label: Routing Rules
sections.description: Request routing rules connecting listeners to backend pools.

fields.label: Request Routing Rules
fields.description: Rules that evaluate incoming requests on listeners and route them.

fields.label: Rule Name
fields.description: Name of the routing rule.

fields.label: Rule Type
fields.description: Type of rule: Basic or PathBasedRouting.

fields.label: HTTP Listener Name
fields.description: Name of the listener this rule applies to.

fields.label: Backend Pool Name
fields.description: Name of the backend address pool to route traffic to.

fields.label: Backend HTTP Settings Name
fields.description: Name of backend HTTP settings to use.

fields.label: Redirect Configuration Name
fields.description: Name of redirect configuration (if redirecting).

fields.label: Rewrite Rule Set Name
fields.description: Name of URL/header rewrite rule set.

fields.label: URL Path Map Name
fields.description: Name of URL path map (for PathBasedRouting).

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Rule evaluation priority (1 to 20000, required for v2 SKUs).

sections.label: Health Probes & SSL Certificates
sections.description: Custom health check probes and SSL certificate configurations.

fields.label: Custom Health Probes
fields.description: List of custom health probe configurations.

fields.label: SSL Certificates
fields.description: List of SSL certificates (from Key Vault or certificate data).

fields.label: Key Vault Secret ID
fields.description: Secret ID (versionless) in Azure Key Vault containing the SSL certificate.

sections.label: WAF & Security
sections.description: Web Application Firewall policy and FIPS configurations.

fields.label: WAF Policy ID
fields.description: Global Web Application Firewall Policy resource ID to associate with the Application Gateway.

fields.label: Force Firewall Policy Association
fields.description: Whether to force association of the firewall policy.

fields.label: Enable FIPS
fields.description: Whether FIPS 140-2 compliance is enabled.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags for governance and cost tracking.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value pairs to assign to the Application Gateway.
